descricao: Each skyscraper in Level 45 creates its own local field of gravity that is relative to the orientation of the structure. Any object that is thrown out of the building will float weightlessly until it comes into the influence of another skyscraper's gravity. It should be noted that this weightless effect does not extend to most living things. If a human or an entity were to drop off the edge of one of these skyscrapers, they would continue to be affected by gravity in the direction of the skyscraper which they had just exited.
